about_the_game:
ELARIENNE: Everything Comes Down to Luck

ELARIENNE is a pure luck-based defense game where every summon can change your fate.

A defense game where luck shapes your army—and strategy keeps you alive.

Every unit is summoned randomly—from the most basic tier all the way to the ultra-rare Mystic tier.

There are 8 tiers in total, and each unit belongs to one of three races: Humans, Elves, or Orcs.

Each race has its own distinct combat traits, making team-building both exciting and unpredictable.

Want to build your dream army? You’ll need some serious luck.

As darkness spreads across the land, only fortune can protect the world of ELARIENNE.

Test your luck in this ultimate defense challenge.

Runes: Luck or Strategy

What matters more—luck or strategy?

Defeat minibosses and bosses to choose from three random runes.

  • Bosses grant Support Runes

  • Epic Bosses grant powerful Attack Runes

Each rune gives you another chance to shape your strategy—or roll the dice again.

Survive 150 Waves

Enemies appear in waves and follow a fixed looping path.

If you don’t defeat them, they stay on the field and stack with future waves.

Let 100 enemies build up on the map, or fail to kill a boss before time runs out, and your run ends.

When too many monsters gather, the darkness consumes ELARIENNE and the world falls.

Hold the line before it’s too late.

Random Yet Tactical

No run is ever the same.

The units you summon shape how you choose runes and upgrades—turning randomness into strategy.

Will luck be on your side? Or will you fall to the darkness?
